mapper.select: SELECT spd.package_tier, spd.package_level, spd.package_level_exp, spd.reward_kinds, spd.reward_count, spd.reward_item_idx, spd.reward_item_level, spd.reward_item_grade, COALESCE(uspid.seasion_package_received, 0) as seasion_package_received FROM season_package_data spd LEFT JOIN user_season_package_insert_data uspid ON spd.package_tier = uspid.season_package_tier AND spd.package_level = uspid.season_package_level AND uspid.season_number = #{season_number} AND uspid.user_uuid = #{user_uuid} ORDER BY spd.package_tier, spd.package_level;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_season_package_exp_data (user_uuid, season_package_exp, season_package_tier, season_number, season_start_date, season_end_date, ins_date, ins_ip, ins_machine) VALUES (#{user_uuid}, 0, 0, #{season_number}, #{season_start_date}, #{season_end_date}, NOW(), #{ins_ip}, #{ins_machine})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_season_package_exp_data SET season_package_exp = LEAST(12000, season_package_exp + #{season_exp}) WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} and season_number = #{season_number}
mapper.select: SELECT season_package_exp, season_package_tier, season_number, season_start_date, season_end_date FROM user_season_package_exp_data WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND season_number = #{season_number}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_season_package_insert_data (user_uuid, season_number, season_package_tier, season_package_level, seasion_package_received, ins_ip, ins_date, ins_machine) VALUES (#{user_uuid}, #{season_number}, #{season_package_tier}, #{season_package_level}, #{seasion_package_received}, #{ins_ip}, Now(), #{ins_machine})

INSERT INTO season_number_date_data (season_number, season_start_date, season_end_date, season_level_exp, season_start_end, ins_date) VALUES (#{season_number}, #{season_start_date}, #{season_end_date}, 400, 'start', Now())
mapper.update: UPDATE season_number_date_data SET season_start_end = 'end' WHERE season_number = #{season_number}
mapper.select: SELECT IF(u.last_login >= s.season_start_date, 'true', 'false') AS is_season_started FROM user_data u JOIN (SELECT MAX(season_start_date) AS season_start_date FROM season_number_date_data WHERE season_start_date <= NOW()) s ON 1=1 WHERE u.user_uuid = #{user_uuid}
